user.title: Set up Hearth
user.description: Your household's Hearth TVs, phones and tablets pair with Home Assistant from their own settings (on a TV: Settings > Home Assistant > Pair with Home Assistant). Each one that asks shows up here to confirm.

confirm.title: Pair {name}?
confirm.description:
Check that {name} shows this code:

**{code}**

{client}Pair it only if the codes match. A device you don't recognize, or a code that doesn't match, may be someone else's: close this instead.

data_description.person: For a phone or tablet: the person it belongs to. Its screen time counts for them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. TVs and phones pair from their own settings.
abort.expired: This request has ended. Ask again from the TV or phone.

menu_options.enforce: Enforce limits (Family Link, Family Safety, Nintendo)

people.title: Who's who on the TVs
people.description: Each Google TV profile the household's TVs have reported, and the person it is. A profile is listed by its name, once for all the TVs that have it; one from a TV with an older Hearth is listed for that TV only. Leave a guest or shared profile empty: its time counts for nobody. Old mappings by number (user:10) aren't listed: saving drops them. A profile not listed yet can be added below by its name ref (name:sam) or one TV's key (<device id>/user:11).

data.profile_id: Another profile's ref or TV key

add_group.title: Add a category
add_group.description: A category's apps count together on every device, and it can have a limit within daily time. For example YouTube: YouTube and HearthTube.

group_apps.title: Add apps to Games
group_apps.description: Apps Android marks as games are in Games already. Add the ones it misses. An app is in one category: an app added here leaves any other.

not_screen_time.title: Not screen time
not_screen_time.description: Categories whose time doesn't count toward daily time (music, say). Their apps aren't held when daily time runs out; a limit of their own still applies.

parent_pin.title: Parent PINs
parent_pin.description: Each adult's own parent PIN (set now: {people}). Any of them unlocks a parent's settings. Paired TVs use these in place of their own Parent PIN, and phones check them here; a phone never gets a PIN. They're kept as hashes. After 5 wrong tries a device waits, longer each time.

push.title: Push to phones
push.description: An ntfy server (ntfy.sh, or your own) through which Home Assistant tells a paired phone that something changed, so it fetches its state at once instead of at its next check. Each phone listens on its own random topic; the ping only says "changed", never a name or a number. Leave it empty for no pings.

app_categories.title: App categories
app_categories.description: Hearth knows what many apps are (a game, YouTube, streaming, a companion app) from its starter list. When a kid first uses an app it doesn't know, Hearth can look the app's genre up in its store (Google Play, Microsoft Store, Steam): that sends the app's public store id and nothing else. When the genre is unclear, an AI is asked: by default Home Assistant's default AI Task (Settings > AI Task; a local model works), or one you choose, or none. It gets the app's name, store id and the store's one-line description, at most 20 apps a day; its answer is only a guess and never puts an app in Messaging, Accessibility or System screens. Your own choice on Hearth's page always wins.

data.lookup: Look new apps up in their store

voice_assistants.title: Voice assistants
voice_assistants.description: Let voice assistants use Hearth: an Assist pipeline (a voice satellite) with Hearth among its LLM APIs answers questions about the kids' screen time, and its actions (more time, a pause, an allow) go to the adults' phones to approve first. Off: voice gets nothing from Hearth. Adults signed in to Home Assistant (Assist chat, the MCP Server) use Hearth either way.

remove_group.title: Remove a category
remove_group.description: Its limits and raised limits go with it.

add_source.title: Add a screen time source
add_source.description: Another integration's sensor: time today (Family Link's Daily Screen Time, Family Safety's Screen Time, Nintendo's Used screen time), or, with Live on, what's being played now (Xbox's Now playing, a Switch presence Game sensor), which Hearth times itself. If it's the same device as a Hearth device or another source, say so: its minutes are then counted once.

data.name: Name
data.live: Live: it says what's being played now

data_description.group: For time it can't put on an app: Games for a Switch or Xbox. A Nintendo Switch Parental Controls sensor is Games when left empty.

add_title.title: Add a title
add_title.description: One game or app by every name it has: the Android package, its name on Xbox and Switch, the PC app. Its time is counted together, and people on it at the same time are playing together.

locks.title: Locks
locks.description: Sensors that are on while this person may not watch, such as Family Link's bedtime and school time ones. While any is on, the person's Hearth devices hold their apps. Choosing a person again replaces their locks; none clears them.

new_apps.title: Watch for new apps
new_apps.description: Apps the kids start using on Hearth's devices are noticed by themselves. Add sensors that list a kid's allowed apps (Family Link's Apps without limits and Apps with time limits) to notice an app as soon as it's allowed. Requests for more time, offers and chores done go to every adult's Home Assistant companion app, and to the phone chosen here, if any.

data.ask_off: Adults whose own phones don't get requests
data.ask_deep_link: Adults whose Android phones open hearth://ask/<id> (their own app) instead of Hearth's page

sort_apps.title: Sort new apps
sort_apps.description: The category each new app counts in. Other: only daily time. Leave one empty to sort it later.

school_days.title: School days
school_days.description: Which daily time applies today: the school-day one or the other-day one. Give any mix of these; the first that answers decides: the dates below, then the entity, then the calendar, then Monday to Friday within the school year.

data.entity: An entity that says what today is
data.school_states: Its states that mean a school day
data.keywords: Only events whose title has one of these words
data.year_start: First day of the school year
data.year_end: Last day of the school year
data.half_states: The entity's states that mean a half day
data.half_keywords: Calendar events that mean a half day

data_description.entity: A helper an automation keeps, the Workday integration's sensor, an input_boolean. Unavailable passes the question on.
data_description.school_states: Separated by commas. Leave empty for on, school, true, yes.
data_description.keywords: Separated by commas, for a calendar of days off: closed, break, holiday. Empty: any event.
data_description.days_off: Dates (2026-11-26) or ranges (2026-12-24..2027-01-01), separated by commas or new lines.
data_description.extra_school_days: Same, for days that are school days although they'd be off.
data_description.half_days: School days that end early, as dates or ranges. Schedule says what a half day does.
data_description.half_states: Separated by commas. Leave empty for half, half_day.
data_description.half_keywords: Words in an event's title (early dismissal, half day), separated by commas.

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.description: When one of this person's categories is out of time, their Hearth TVs and phones stop its apps. Here, other parental controls can hold them too, until it has time again (more time, a new day). Family Link pauses the category's Android apps (they stay installed; Google TV ignores this, Hearth holds the TV); for daily time it locks the person's devices instead, and apps with unlimited time still work. Family Safety locks the platforms below while one of its categories below is out of time, until midnight. Nintendo suspends the Switch's game while one of its categories below is out of time (Max screentime today set to 0, with Suspend software on), and puts its limit and Suspend software back after. Choosing a person again replaces theirs; leaving them all empty stops it, and what was held is let go. Family Link backstop (on by default): each kid's Family Link daily limit today is kept at their daily time + bonus time left + a margin (rounded up to 5 minutes), and a whole day while Unlimited is on. Hearth's own holds stay the real limit; the backstop wins over a weekday limit changed in the Family Link app.

data.family_link: Family Link: any of the person's Family Link entities
data.family_safety: Family Safety: the person's account sensor
data.groups: Family Safety: lock while one of these categories (or daily time) is out of time
data.nintendo: Nintendo: the person's Switch (its Max screentime today)
data.nintendo_groups: Nintendo: suspend while one of these categories (or daily time) is out of time
data.nintendo_playing: A shared Switch: held only while this person is the one playing (their playing sensor)
data.school_time_apps: Family Link: during School time, pause these apps
data.fl_backstop: Keep Family Link's daily limit as a backstop

data_description.school_time_apps: Paused while the person's Family Link School time is on (any of their devices), and resumed when it ends. Google Messages by default: it stays installed and keeps incoming texts. Empty: nothing.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: What each kind of day does to the kids' Family Link (the day type comes from School days). On a day off, School time can be switched off for the day; Hearth puts it back at the start of the next school day, inside each kid's own window. On a half day, School time can end some hours early. Both can give extra time: as Family Link's daily limit for today only (the weekday's limit plus the extra), on Family Safety's limits for the day (Windows, Xbox: the weekday's limit plus the extra; off unless chosen) and on each kid's Switch (its limit plus the extra; off unless chosen), both put back by Hearth just before midnight or when the day off is called off, and/or as Hearth bonus time. At the watchdog time on a school day, the adults are told if anyone's School time is still off.

data.half_day_hours_early: Half day: School time ends this many hours early
data.bonus_family_link: Extra minutes as Family Link's daily limit today (with Hearth's Family Link backstop on, Hearth's bonus time sets it)
data.bonus_family_safety: Extra minutes as Family Safety's daily limits today (Windows, Xbox)
data.bonus_nintendo: Extra minutes on the Switch's limit today (put back at midnight)
data.bonus_group: Extra minutes also as Hearth bonus time
data.people: Who (empty: everyone with Family Link, Family Safety or a Switch in Enforce)
data.notify: Tell this phone (empty: the one that answers requests for more time)

site_list.title: Website block list
site_list.description: Every day at this time, each person's blocked sites in Family Link and Family Safety are brought in step with a published list: new domains are added, and only what the list itself added before is taken out. A failure for one person is logged and the others go on.

data.people: Who (empty: everyone with Family Link or Family Safety in Enforce)

suggest_push.title: Suggest more time to phones
suggest_push.description: When one of these groups of the kid's runs out, its suggestion (give more, or not today) also goes to the adults' phones, once a day. Nothing is asked of the kid. Choosing a kid again replaces their groups; no groups stops it. Also in the Kids tab of Hearth's page.

data.groups: When one of these runs out

places.title: Places
places.description: Places are Home Assistant zones: Hearth keeps no coordinates and shows only a place's name. Home is always zone.home. Give a kid their school's zone (and, if Hearth doesn't find it, their Family Link location tracker): choosing a kid again replaces theirs. Add a favorite place by its zone and the name to show, or remove favorites. A router's or Wi-Fi tracker is never used. Favorites now: {favorites}.

data.tracker: Their Family Link location tracker (if not found)
data.favorite_zone: Add a favorite place: its zone

error.already_added: That sensor is a source already.
error.bad_profile_id: Give a ref like name:sam (or a TV's key, <device id>/user:11), and its person.
error.not_adult: Only an adult has a parent PIN: mark them as an adult on Hearth's page (Family) first.
error.bad_server: Give the server's address, like https://ntfy.example.com (no user name, password or query).
error.not_https: The address must start with https://
error.too_many_favorites: That's as many favorite places as Hearth keeps (20).

abort.no_profiles: No TV has reported its profiles yet. Pair a TV and let it post its status first.
abort.no_groups: There are no groups of your own to remove.

pause.name: Pause screens
pause.description: Holds the people's Hearth devices (dinner time, say) for some minutes, until a time, or until they arrive at or leave a place; they stop and show the reason. Everyone in the household when no one is chosen.

until.name: Until
until.description: Or until this time (tomorrow's, if it has passed today).

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: What the devices show, such as Dinner.

ends_on.name: Ends on
ends_on.description: Or ends sooner, for each person, when they arrive at a place or leave one: {"arrive": "home"}, {"leave": "school"} or a favorite place's key. The time (the end of the day when none is given) stays the cap; an unknown or stale place never ends it.

app.name: App
app.description: Pause only this app (its package name), not every app.

group.name: Group
group.description: Pause only this group's apps (its id or name, such as youtube), not every app.

pause_end.name: End Pause screens
pause_end.description: Lets the people go again (everyone paused when no one is chosen).

app.name: App
app.description: End only the pause of this app. With no app or group, only the family pause ends.

group.name: Group
group.description: End only the pause of this group.

add_bonus.name: Add bonus time (older name)
add_bonus.description: Kept for older automations: with no group (or all) it is bonus time today, as add_time; with a category's group it raises that category's limit today by the minutes, as raise_cap (negative lowers it). Use add_time or raise_cap.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes (negative takes them away).

group.name: Group (deprecated)
group.description: Deprecated: bonus time has no category. A category's id raises its limit instead.

device.name: Device
device.description: Only on this device of theirs, today (a target id from the household summary: hearth:<id>, fl:<id>, fs:xbox, fs:windows, nintendo:<entity>): it may go past their daily time there.

remove_bonus.name: Take back bonus time (older name)
remove_bonus.description: Kept for older automations: takes back bonus time given today (no group, or all; as remove_time), or lowers a category's raised limit again. Never more than was given.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes to take back.

group.name: Group (deprecated)
group.description: Deprecated: all, or a category whose limit was raised.

set_budget.name: Set daily time or a category's limit
set_budget.description: Sets a person's daily time (group all) or a category's limit, on school days, other days, or both. Leave minutes empty for no limit.

group.name: Daily time or category
group.description: all for daily time, or a category's id: games, youtube, or one of your own.

days.name: Days
days.description: school_days, other_days, or both (weekday and weekend are older names for the first two).

get_watch_log.name: Get the videos started
get_watch_log.description: The YouTube videos a person started in HearthTube in a kids profile, newest first, and what a parent blocked for them.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose videos (a person with a TV profile).

days.name: Days
days.description: Only the last this many days (leave empty for all that is kept, up to 2,000).

watch_digest.name: Watch digest
watch_digest.description: One document for the last days: per kid, the videos started, counts per channel and per day, what was blocked, and a short readable summary.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose (leave empty for everyone with a TV profile).

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back (7: a week).

block_video.name: Block a video on YouTube
block_video.description: Blocks a video in HearthTube for a person's kids profiles. The kid can't undo it; the TV gets it with its next status (within a few minutes).

person.name: Person
person.description: For whom (a person with a TV profile).

video.name: Video
video.description: A video id or a YouTube link.

label.name: Label
label.description: What to show for it (a title, a name). Optional.

unblock_video.name: Unblock a video on YouTube
unblock_video.description: Takes back a video blocked here.

video.name: Video
video.description: A video id or a YouTube link.

block_channel.name: Block a channel on YouTube
block_channel.description: Blocks a channel in HearthTube for a person's kids profiles. The kid can't undo it; the TV gets it with its next status (within a few minutes).

person.name: Person
person.description: For whom (a person with a TV profile).

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: A channel id (UC...) or a youtube.com/channel/ link; a handle (@name) won't do.

label.name: Label
label.description: What to show for it (a title, a name). Optional.

unblock_channel.name: Unblock a channel on YouTube
unblock_channel.description: Takes back a channel blocked here.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: A channel id (UC...) or a youtube.com/channel/ link; a handle (@name) won't do.

block_word.name: Block a word on YouTube
block_word.description: Blocks a word in HearthTube for a person's kids profiles. The kid can't undo it; the TV gets it with its next status (within a few minutes).

person.name: Person
person.description: For whom (a person with a TV profile).

word.name: Word
word.description: A word or words; videos whose title has it are hidden (titles only).

unblock_word.name: Unblock a word on YouTube
unblock_word.description: Takes back a word blocked here.

word.name: Word
word.description: A word or words; videos whose title has it are hidden (titles only).

play_on_tv.name: Play on a TV
play_on_tv.description: Starts a link, a YouTube video (in HearthTube) or an app on a Hearth TV. The TV takes it with its next status, within about 2 minutes while it's on, and plays it as if picked there: a kids profile's limits and blocks still apply. Answers the command's id; hearth_command_done says how it went.

device_id.name: TV
device_id.description: The Hearth TV (its device, or its Hearth device id).

what.name: What
what.description: A link (http or https), a YouTube video id or link, or an app's package name (com.example.app).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Optional: the TV profile to play it in (an id like user:10, or a person with one profile on the TV). The TV switches to it first, asking for its PIN as usual.

allow.name: Allow
allow.description: Lets people use an app or a group until a time: while it lasts, Hearth holds it nowhere for them (their TVs and phones, Family Link, the School-time pause). Bedtime, School time itself and a family pause still lock them. Returns its id.

app.name: App
app.description: One app, by its package name. Or a group.

group.name: Group
group.description: A Hearth group (youtube), or all for everything Hearth holds.

until.name: Until
until.description: A time (tomorrow's if it has passed), school_time_end (the end of their School time today) or end_of_day (the default).

ends_on.name: Ends on
ends_on.description: Or ends sooner, for each person, when they arrive at a place or leave one: {"arrive": "home"}, {"leave": "school"} or a favorite place's key. The time stays the cap; an unknown or stale place never ends it.

device.name: Device
device.description: Only on this device of theirs (a target id): the group is open there until the time. Only daily time on a Family Link device, a Family Safety platform or a Switch.

allow_end.name: End an allow
allow_end.description: Ends an allow early: by its id, or the people's (of an app or a group, when given). A parent's grant (from the Family Link, Nintendo or Family Safety app) ends by its id too. What should hold then holds again.

id.name: Id
id.description: The id hearth.allow returned, or a parent grant's id.

device.name: Device
device.description: End the extra time given on this device (a target id): its bonus or allow there.

explain.name: Explain
explain.description: Why an app or a group is held for a person now, or isn't: allowed, until, blocked_by (budget, bedtime, school_time, pause, school_time_apps), and the allows that apply.

app.name: App
app.description: An app, by its package name. Or a group.

school_time_off.name: School time off
school_time_off.description: Switches the people's Family Link School time off on a date (today by default), from a time if given. Hearth puts it back at the start of their next school day, inside each one's own window, and pins today's hours.

people.name: People
people.description: Who (each needs Family Link in Configure > Enforce).

from.name: From
from.description: From this time; the whole day when empty.

ends_on.name: Ends on
ends_on.description: Today only: School time comes back sooner, for each person, when they arrive at a place or leave one: {"arrive": "school"}, {"leave": "home"} or a favorite place's key. An unknown or stale place never ends it.

school_time_off_cancel.name: Cancel School time off
school_time_off_cancel.description: One not started yet is dropped; one already off is put back from today (inside the window, as always).

answer_request.name: Answer a request for more time
answer_request.description: Answers a kid's request for more time (or an offer): more minutes today, or not now. The first answer wins; a later one is refused. Returns the request as its device sees it.

request_id.name: Request
request_id.description: The request's id (the household summary's approvals, or the hearth_more_time_requested event).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Extra minutes today (1-600). Give this or Deny.

deny.name: Deny
deny.description: Not now (starts a short wait before the kid may ask again).

copy_sites.name: Copy websites between Family Link and Family Safety
copy_sites.description: Copies a kid's blocked (or allowed) websites from Family Link to Family Safety, the other way round, or both. Only adds: a site with a path isn't copied, a site a website list sync added is left to it, and a site blocked on one side and allowed on the other is left on both. Returns, per person, what was added and what was left.

people.name: People
people.description: Whose websites (everyone with both Family Link and Family Safety in Configure > Enforce when none).

from.name: From
from.description: Which side's sites are copied to the other: family_link, family_safety or both.

lists.name: Lists
lists.description: Which lists: blocked (the default), allowed or both.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only say what would be added, without adding anything.

chore_undo.name: Undo a chore's reward
chore_undo.description: Takes back, whole, the reward a checked-off item on a kid's to-do list gave (the Undo on its notice). The item stays done.

key.name: Reward
key.description: The reward's ledger key, as the notice and the panel have it.

dismiss_suggestion.name: Not today for a suggestion
dismiss_suggestion.description: Puts one of a person's suggestions (the household summary's suggestions) off for the rest of the day.

key.name: Suggestion
key.description: The suggestion's key, such as more:games or device:fs:xbox.

set_schedule.name: Set the schedule
set_schedule.description: Sets the people's weekly schedule for some days: the changes (each a time, snapped to 15 minutes, and a mode that runs until the next) and/or the time each day per group. What's given replaces what was there; a group not given keeps its limit. Returns an undo token.

days.name: Days
days.description: mon to sun, day_off, or several at once: school_days (Monday to Friday), weekend, every_day (with the Day off), and for bedtimes school_nights (Sunday to Thursday) and weekend_nights (Friday and Saturday).

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: The day's changes: [{"at": "07:45", "mode": "school"}, ...], at most 12. The last one runs past midnight until the next day's first.

bedtime.name: Bedtime
bedtime.description: The days' bedtime from now on: their last Sleep moves here (or one is added). Not with changes. Family Link and Family Safety follow when bedtime sync is on.

wake.name: Wake
wake.description: The days' wake from now on: their first change moves here. Not with changes.

limits.name: Time each day
limits.description: Minutes per group: {"all": 180, "games": 60}; null is no limit, 0 is none.

half_day_ends.name: Half day: School ends at
half_day_ends.description: On a half day, School ends at this time, then whatever came after it.

half_day_limits.name: Half day's limits
half_day_limits.description: day_off (the Day off's) or weekday (that weekday's).

copy_schedule.name: Copy the schedule
copy_schedule.description: Copies one day of a person's to other days of theirs, or their week (or one day) to other people. What's copied replaces what was there. Returns an undo token.

day.name: Day
day.description: The day to copy; to other people, the whole week when empty.

to_days.name: To days
to_days.description: Or copy the day to these days of the same person's.

times.name: The times
times.description: Copy the changes (Sleep, School, Free time...).

change_today.name: Change today
change_today.description: Changes today only, until midnight: a later or earlier bedtime, a mode from now until a time (the next change by default), the whole day's changes, and/or today's limits. The weekly schedule stays as it is.

bedtime.name: Bedtime
bedtime.description: Tonight's bedtime: "let Sam stay up until 10".

wake.name: Wake tomorrow
wake.description: Tomorrow morning's wake, this once: tonight's Sleep runs until then.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: A mode from now (Homework, Free time...).

until.name: Until
until.description: When the mode ends; the next change when empty.

sync_bedtimes.name: Keep bedtimes in step
sync_bedtimes.description: Starts keeping the kids' bedtime in step in Family Link and Family Safety (the first sync, after a preview), checks again for kids already in step, or stops. Returns, per kid, its state and what each app gets.

people.name: People
people.description: Which kids; every kid with Family Link or Family Safety when empty.

start_from.name: Start from
start_from.description: auto (Hearth's schedule when it has a Sleep, else the apps' bedtime), hearth, family_link or family_safety.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Say what would be written and imported, and write nothing.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Write nothing more for them. Nothing is put back: the apps keep the hours they have.

family_link_bedtime_on.name: Turn Family Link's bedtime back on
family_link_bedtime_on.description: Switch Family Link's bedtime on again after a parent switched it off.

bedtime_offer.name: Answer a bedtime change
bedtime_offer.description: Answers a bedtime changed in Family Link or Family Safety: keep it every week in Hearth's schedule (every app follows), or put Hearth's back in that app.

id.name: Offer
id.description: The offer's id (in the kid's bedtime_sync offers).

accept.name: Keep it
accept.description: On: make it that weekday's bedtime for good. Off: put Hearth's back.

resume_schedule.name: Back to the schedule
resume_schedule.description: Drops today's change: the people are back on their weekly schedule.

get_schedule.name: Get the schedule
get_schedule.description: A person's day as the schedule has it: its changes, limits, bedtime and wake, and which day it uses (a weekday, the Day off, the Half day, or today's change). Today when no date or day is given.

date.name: Date
date.description: A date (its day type decides the day it uses).

day.name: Day
day.description: Or a day of the week, the Day off or the Half day.

block_app.name: Block an app
block_app.description: Blocks Android apps for kids through Family Link, kept by Hearth: blocked again when the app comes back, never paused or resumed by Hearth's holds, and an allow doesn't lift it.

people.name: Kids
people.description: Who; every kid with Family Link when empty.

block_outside_app.name: Block an app loosened outside Hearth
block_outside_app.description: The button on Hearth's notice of an app unblocked, its limit raised or taken off, or always allowed in Family Link, Family Safety or Nintendo without Hearth: blocks it again there (Family Link: as Hearth's own block; Nintendo: off the Switch's allow list).

source.name: List
source.description: The list the notice is about, as the notice's button gives it.

app.name: App
app.description: The app's id in that list.

unblock_app.name: Unblock an app
unblock_app.description: Ends Hearth's block of Android apps. Only a block Hearth made is lifted in Family Link: a parent's own block there stays.

add_time.name: Give bonus time
add_time.description: Bonus time today: adds minutes to daily time, with no category. The kid may spend it anywhere, minutes past a category's limit included (one bonus shared by every category). Ends at midnight. Family Link and Family Safety get as much where they would stop sooner.

category.name: Category
category.description: A bonus for this category only ("+15 min Messaging bonus"): usable there past daily time and its limit. Leave it out for the general bonus.

remove_time.name: Take back bonus time
remove_time.description: Takes back bonus time an adult gave today (an undo): never more than was given.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes to take back.

raise_cap.name: Raise limit
raise_cap.description: Raises a category's limit today (by some minutes, to some minutes, or no limit) until a time, the end of the day by default. Daily time is unchanged.

category.name: Category
category.description: The category's id: games, youtube, or one of your own.

minutes.name: By minutes
minutes.description: Raise the limit by this many minutes (negative lowers it).

no_cap.name: No limit
no_cap.description: No limit for the category today.

raise_cap_end.name: End a raised limit
raise_cap_end.description: A category's raised limit ends now (every raised one when no category is given).

unlimited.name: Unlimited
unlimited.description: Unlimited until a time (until 6 PM, until turned off, the end of the day by default; always over at midnight): no daily time or category limit holds them, and the time they use isn't counted, so daily time, limits and bonus time pick up where they were. Bedtime, School time and Pause screens still apply, unless include bedtime is on (bedtime only).

until.name: Until
until.description: A time, end_of_day (the default), or turned_off (until an adult ends it).

include_bedtime.name: Include bedtime
include_bedtime.description: Bedtime doesn't lock them meanwhile either.

unlimited_end.name: End unlimited
unlimited_end.description: Unlimited ends now: limits are back on where they were when it started.

get_activity.name: Get activity
get_activity.description: What Hearth did, newest first (kept 14 days): its calls to Family Link, Family Safety, Nintendo and others with their result, the holds it started and ended, TV commands and Glint inbox writes. People and devices by their ids, never a name.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: call, hold_start, hold_end, tv_command, glint_inbox or rule.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: At most this many (200 by default).

end_grant.name: End a grant
end_grant.description: Ends exactly the change one origin made (its id from a person's today's origins): takes back a bonus's unused minutes, ends one raised limit or one Unlimited grant (the others stay in effect), undoes a chore's reward, or ends Pause screens.

pairing_answer.name: Answer a pairing
pairing_answer.description: Approves or denies a device waiting to pair (an administrator's Approve or Deny on the phone notification). Administrators only.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose phone it is (a phone only).

adult_offer_answer.name: Answer an offer to make someone an adult
adult_offer_answer.description: Answers Hearth's offer for a person who signed in from a phone: adult makes them an adult on Hearth's page, not_now never asks again. Administrators only.

tv_profile_keys.title: Pick the kids' TV profiles again
tv_profile_keys.description: Hearth used to map TV profiles by their number ({keys}), but each TV numbers its profiles itself: the same number is a different kid on each TV, so one kid could get another's limits. Those mappings are no longer used. Open Hearth's page (Devices, TV profiles) or Hearth's Configure menu and pick whose each profile is. Profiles are now listed by name, one choice for every TV. Removing or replacing the old entries clears this message.
